note: A human read of the research type each turn ran under, for the twelve sessions whose export field `Filter: Research mode` is blank (the feedback snapshot predates the column). Keyed by session id, then by the 1-based user-turn index `replay_set.Turn.index` uses. Evidence notes describe the answer's behaviour and name public judgments only; they never quote a lawyer's question. `classification.json` stays frozen; this file sits beside it. Values: legislation_only | legislation_and_case_law | case_law_only | case_law_included (case law was in the tool set; whether legislation was too is not settled, so the harness sends legislation_and_case_law and labels it reviewer_partial) | unknown (nothing settles it; the harness labels it unknown and sends the nearest read in the same session, else legislation_only). Basis: answer (the turn's own saved answer, read against the pre-pilot prompts), lawyer (the lawyer's own words, in a later turn or the feedback form), bracketed (the same value is read on both sides with no evidence of a change between).
mechanism: At the pre-pilot (product commit f8fe9ec), the research type was ONE saved preference per user (`users.research_mode`, default legislation_only), changed only by applying the Research filters modal, and it persisted across chats and logins. So a change is an event, and a turn between two reads of the same value for the same lawyer ran under that value unless the lawyer changed it and changed it back. In Conversational mode the research type decided three things a saved answer can show: legislation_only gave the Manager a note to decline case-law questions (it declined every such question in these sessions: 6335 t3, 6343 t1-t2, 6350 t2; the planner likewise); legislation_and_case_law gave the Manager a note to brief the Worker to ALSO search case law, and the Worker the search_case_law tool, whose description carries the coverage wording (England & Wales and UK-wide courts; Court of Session and Sheriff Courts not indexed); case_law_only removed the legislation tools and told the Manager to say so when asked about legislation. A neutral citation alone is NOT evidence: a refusal quotes the case the lawyer named.
authoritative_source: The target's `request_timings.research_mode` (and `chat_mode`) recorded the resolved type of every pre-pilot request (column since 9e69e4c, 2026-07-14). It has no chat or user id, but `created_at` and `total_cost_usd` join it to the export's assistant messages. That query would replace this read; it needs the target (FIX_PLAN P0.7).
